Please go to the `Preview` tab and select the appropriate sub-template:

* [Creation Review](?expand=1&template=01_creation_review.md): Use when adding a new specification project to the website.
* [Plan Review](?expand=1&template=02_plan_review.md): Use when a specification project is proposing the plan for a new release.
* [Progress Review](?expand=1&template=03_progress_review.md): Use when a specification project is publishing a milestone (`Mn`) for a Progress Review.
* [Release Review](?expand=1&template=04_release_review.md): Use when a specification project is publishing a final Major or Minor release (`x.y`) that requires a Release Review.
* [Service Release](?expand=1&template=05_service_release.md): Use when a specification project is publishing a service release (`x.y.z`) of a previously approved release. No Release Review is required.
